name: giant spider
desc: Giant Spider is a CR 1 beast.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=2AyYbFLKLbDLzP05]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is &reference[stable] but &reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=2AyYbFLKLbDLzP05]], even after regaining hit points, and is &reference[paralyzed] while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: web
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. Hit: The target is &Reference[restrained] by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a [[/check activity=aELnqvc37WaAm0IG]] check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: web sense
actions.desc: While in contact with a web, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
